data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that associates a passenger train with a textual train or service identifier.
data_properties.label: has train service code
data_properties.rationale: A rail service identifier is not the same as tail number, ICAO code, Mode S code, or reservation number, so those existing datatype properties are not reused.

data_properties.definition: A datatype relation that associates a rail journey plan with the departure time specified by that plan.
data_properties.label: has planned departure time
data_properties.rationale: Planned time belongs on the plan, not on the journey process. Existing has_boarding_time is not reused because boarding time and planned departure time are different.

design_warnings: This is a candidate TBox design report, not approved ontology assertions and not OWL axioms.
Air analogues are comparisons only. Do not assert owl:equivalentClass between rail classes and airplane, airport, flight plan, ticket, reservation, or passenger classes.

Rail journey is a BFO process. Rail journey plan and rail reservation information are information content entities. Rail ticket is modeled as a material information bearer. These must not be collapsed.

The local reservation class is asserted under material information bearer, while the CCO reservation class is reservation information under IAO information content entity. Rail reservation information follows the CCO ICE class and must not be parented under the local bearer class.
Rail passenger role is parented exactly under BFO role. It is not a person, not a subtype of person, and not a subclass of the supplied passenger class in this proposal.

No named individuals, person-specific trip records, social-media classes, threat classifications, or statements about specific persons are proposed. Source classes and properties for posting, affiliation, accomplice, or person-of-interest roles are out of scope.

Railway station is parented under the supplied building class to mirror airport. That IRI is not in the short offered-parent list; retarget to BFO object if that list is treated as exclusive. Station site or location is not separately modeled.
Do not invent BFO, IAO, or CCO IRIs that were not supplied. Existing datatype properties for airports, boarding, names, and reservation numbers are not duplicated.
Source quality issues include the misspelled commercial-airplane IRI, unlabeled ticket, and inconsistent reservation typing. Do not copy those defects into equivalence or reuse decisions.

object_properties.definition: A relation that holds between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey starts.
object_properties.label: departs from station
object_properties.rationale: Needed to relate the travel process to a facility without minting departure-station subclasses. The air datatype property has_departure_airport is not reused, because origin should be a station object rather than a literal.

object_properties.definition: A relation that holds between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey ends.
object_properties.label: arrives at station
object_properties.rationale: Pairs with departure as a process-to-facility relation. The air datatype property has_arrival_airport is not reused and is not treated as an object property.

object_properties.definition: A relation that holds between a rail journey and the train that is the vehicle in which that journey occurs.
object_properties.label: occurs aboard train
object_properties.rationale: Links the travel process to the vehicle. No supplied object property has this meaning, and a BFO participation IRI was not supplied for reuse.

object_properties.definition: A relation that holds between a rail journey plan and the rail journey process that the plan specifies.
object_properties.label: specifies rail journey
object_properties.rationale: Keeps the information content entity distinct from the process it describes. No supplied aboutness property is reused, and this is not an equivalence.

rail_classes.definition: A material object that is a rail vehicle intended to move along railway tracks.
rail_classes.label: train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Airplane is only an air-vehicle comparison and is not reused as a parent or equivalent class. No rail-vehicle class was supplied, so the parent is BFO object, matching Airplane's asserted superclass.
review_notes: Candidate class only; not an approved assertion.
Does not distinguish locomotive, car, and consist.
Do not assert owl:equivalentClass to Airplane.

rail_classes.definition: A train that is designed to transport passengers.
rail_classes.label: passenger train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. This is a specialization of the proposed train class. The commercial-airplane IRI is a comparison only and is misspelled in the source, so it is not a parent.
review_notes: Parent is a proposed class IRI, not an approved ontology assertion.
Freight and maintenance trains are not included.
Do not subclass or equate this class to any airplane class.

rail_classes.definition: A building that is a facility at which rail journeys may start, stop, or end for passenger boarding and alighting.
rail_classes.label: railway station
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Airport is asserted under building, so the station class follows that facility pattern without being equated to airport.
review_notes: Building is a supplied source class, not an invented IRI. If review restricts parents to the short offered-parent list, retarget to BFO object.
The station facility is not the same as its site or spatial location; no site class was offered as a parent.
Departure and arrival are journey relations, not subclasses of station. Do not mint arrival-station or departure-station classes in this pass.

rail_classes.definition: A process in which a train travels from a starting railway station toward an ending railway station.
rail_classes.label: rail journey
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The mandated parent is BFO process. This is the occurrent travel, not a plan, reservation, or ticket.
review_notes: Do not align this process to Act of Flight Plan, which is a planning act rather than travel.
No journey individuals or person-specific trip records are proposed.
Actual timing of the process is not modeled with datatype properties.

rail_classes.definition: An information content entity that specifies an intended rail journey, including planned origin, destination, and timing.
rail_classes.label: rail journey plan
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Flight plan is the information-content comparison and is itself under IAO information content entity. The plan is not the rail journey process.
review_notes: Comparison only; not equivalent to Flight plan.
Planned times belong on this information entity, not on the process.
Do not subclass Act of Flight Plan.

rail_classes.definition: A material information bearer that bears information authorizing participation in a specified rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail ticket
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The requested reading is a material bearer. Supplied ticket is already under IAO material information bearer, and concert ticket follows that parent, so rail ticket is a sibling pattern rather than a new bearer root.
review_notes: Ticket information as a pure information content entity is not this class. Electronic tickets may need a separate ICE if that reading is later required.
The supplied ticket class has no label; confirm its definition before approval.
Do not identify a ticket with a person or a named traveler.

rail_classes.definition: A reservation information content entity that specifies a held entitlement to a planned rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail reservation information
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The CCO reservation class is labeled reservation information and is under IAO information content entity, matching airline reservation information. It is not reused as this class because the names are not exact.
review_notes: Do not parent this under the local reservation class, which is asserted as a material information bearer.
Do not assert equivalence to airline reservation information or to either reservation IRI.
This is not a booking artifact, a trip record, or a statement about a specific person.

rail_classes.definition: A role that inheres in a person and is realized by being transported during a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail passenger role
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The mandated parent is BFO role, not person and not the supplied passenger class. Passenger and Jetblue passenger are comparisons only.
review_notes: A role is not a person and is not a subtype of person.
Do not retarget the parent to passenger in this proposal, even though that source class is asserted under BFO role.
Carrier-specific passenger classes are out of scope. No persons are named.
